incident-bot: ALERT 1779234567 - elevated 5xx rate on /v1/chat/complete (policy: route_error_rate_high) - priority P2
Maya (oncall): taking this one, paging @Liam (sre) and @Tessa (eng-runtime)
Liam (sre): oncall acknowledged, pulling prometheus panels now
Olga (customer-ops): customer "FinApp" reports intermittent failures in integrations between 12:03-12:10 UTC, ~2.5% of calls returning 500s
Tessa (eng-runtime): logs show a spike in KV eviction warnings + several model-serve retries hitting quantized-kernel-fallback path, causing timeouts
Ravi (platform): eu-central shows cross-host error correlation; not single machine. Network spikes look normal.
Maya (oncall): immediate mitigation ideas? We should avoid noise for other oncalls
Liam (sre): propose: 1) enable degraded-route for this tenant to serve smaller-context model, 2) temporarily silence route_error_rate_high for /v1/chat/complete with a 20m silence, 3) scale up gen-pool by +3 nodes in eu-central
scale-bot: scale request submitted: +3 nodes to pool-chat-eu at 12:07:22 UTC
Maya (oncall): applying silence for 20m now (note: mustn't exceed 24h without review)
Tessa (eng-runtime): pushing a hotfix to adjust KV eviction threshold in staging. Also instrumenting a cache-hit heatmap for session-id bucket sizes
Liam (sre): changing alert expression temporarily to require sustained 10m and bump threshold from 4% 5xx -> 7% 5xx for the route while we validate. Will also add a panel for model-fallback-rate to dashboards.
Maya (oncall): temp alert rule being applied: 
```nalert: route_error_rate_high
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/chat/complete",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/chat/complete"}[5m])) > 0.07
for: 10m
``n
Maya (oncall): note: temporary for 24h pending follow-ups
Olga (customer-ops): relaying update to FinApp; they want ETA for full fix and assurance about SLA credits if needed
Tessa (eng-runtime): root-cause working hypothesis: sudden increase in very long-sequence conversations pushed KV cache into thrash, which combined with an edge case in the quantized kernel path led to retries and 500s. Need to profile sequence-length distribution and warmup behavior of quant kernels.
Ravi (platform): creating a new dashboard tab: chat-service -> cache/session metrics + model-fallbacks heatmap. Will add a sequence-length histogram and per-tenant error breakdown panel.
Liam (sre): also adding an alert sanity check job that runs hourly and flags overlapping silences >12h and unattended maintenance windows
Maya (oncall): filing immediate follow-up tickets: TICKET-2001 (cache-eviction-analysis), TICKET-2002 (alert-rule-consolidation), TICKET-2003 (dashboard: chat-cache + fallbacks)
Tessa (eng-runtime): quick prod check commands for engineers: 
```n# cache hit ratio (prom)
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{service="chat"}[1m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{service="chat"}[1m]))
# tail recent eviction warnings
kubectl logs -n gen -l app=chat-service --since=15m | grep -i eviction | tail -n 200
``n
Maya (oncall): current status: error rate down from peak to ~0.8% after degraded-route + scaling; silence active until 12:27 UTC
Olga (customer-ops): customer acknowledged update and requests email when permanent thresholds decided
Ravi (platform): we'll run a focused alert-pruning pass: merge per-host 5xx alerts into a single route-level alert with noise reduction (require 10m sustained) and add exempt-list for low-volume tenants
Liam (sre): agree. For long term: 1) increase cache quota per-tenant dynamically based on sequence-length percentiles, 2) add a regression alert if model-fallback-rate increases after rollouts, 3) add canary check for quant-kernel warmup anomalies
Maya (oncall): scheduling a 45m postmortem sync at 13:00 UTC to review dashboards, decide permanent alert thresholds, and assign owners for the tickets
Ravi (platform): also creating an RFC draft for alert architecture changes and tagging eng-sre for feedback, will drop link in thread when ready
Tessa (eng-runtime): I'll push a canary of eviction-improvement to staging in 2 hours, will measure cache-hit and fallback-rate before any prod rollout
Liam (sre): once canary validated, roll to eu-central canary subset and monitor for 6 hours before global rollout
Maya (oncall): incident thread paused; will reopen if 5xx > 1.5% or if customer reports further failures. Great cross-team response everyone :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED 1779234899 - route_error_rate_high resolved, severity downgraded to P3, duration ~5m
